title: Effective Euler Sums
summary: Euler sums, also called alternating multiple zeta values (MZVs), have been shown to play important roles in many research areas in mathematics and theoretical physics. Motivated by a similar conjecture for MZVs by Kaneko and Zagier, the author proposed a conjectural isomorphism between the space of finite Euler sums and the space of classical ones modulo $ζ(2)$-products. In this paper, we explicitly construct those finite elements (for which we call effective Euler sums) that correspond to the classical Euler sums under this conjecture in depth one and two.
